title: PAF Operational Independence Standard Contract (Step 9)
description: Authority Interface AI-4. Independence is a property of the execution boundary, not of the reviewer's label. The contract requires that at least one mechanism be recorded as non-qualifying, so that relabeling can be named and refused rather than merely discouraged.

coreRule.description: Must state that a different role label, prompt section, or continuation of the same reasoning pass does not by itself constitute independent review.

qualifyingMechanisms.description: Must contain at least one mechanism with qualifies=false. A standard that lists only qualifying mechanisms cannot refuse anything.

rule.description: Must state that a missing required field renders the review NOT_INDEPENDENT and unable to close the gate alone.
